<subject>Re: Any Plans tonight?</subject>
<body>
Hey Shaun!  Sorry I didn't get back with you Friday.  I left a little early, so I must have just missed your message.  Did you guys have a good time on Friday night?  How is everything going?

It has actually been thick around here.  Worked several late nights last week to try and get caught up.  I may have to delay the purchase of the new car with Halcyon's stock taking a hit lately.  It did gain some points on Friday and early today.  Hopefully it keeps it up.

Talked to Max since his wedding?  Haven't heard anything out of him since.  Probably just overcome by marital bliss.
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Palmer, Shaun <shaun.palmer@halcyonbank.co.uk>
Sent: 22 March 2024 15:18
To: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk
Subject: Any Plans tonight?

Hey, what's going on?  My brother-in-law and a friend of his are flying into town tonight?  We're going to head over to The Grindstone (sp?), a place that is supposed to be like The Botanist.  We'll prob get there at about 10:00.  We thought we'd hang there for a while and then head to the city centre and find some kind of bar.  A couple of other friends of mine from B-school will be joining us, I thought you might want to as well.  Are you game?

Write back or give me a call H: +44 7244 382092, cell: +44 20 2529 2161. I'm leaving work in a few minutes if I don't respond to any email.

later,
E

-----Original Message-----
From: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk
Sent: 26 February 2024 01:39
To: Shaun Palmer
Subject: Re: Edinburgh Wedding

Shaun,  Thanks for taking care of that.   I will probably be getting into Edinburgh earlier than you.  I'll have my cell phone with me.  +44 7047 822161. If you get into town earlier, give me a call.  Otherwise why don't you just call me at the room when you get to the hotel.   Sounds great, we'll ride over together.  I might bring this girl I have kinda been seeing with me. My latest victim.  We'll see.    I believe that's correct.  The wedding is at 7.

Thanks for the Torphichen tip.  I was going to ask about that.

G

-----Original Message-----
From: Shaun.J.Palmer@halcyonbank.co.uk
Sent: 26 February 2024 12:09
To: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk
Subject: 2nd Hotel Room

Clifford,

Good news - we were able to get the second room at the same £129 rate. Below you'll see two separate confirmation numbers - I don't think it matters which one you or I use.  When you check in, just claim one of them. They're both on my card so you can transfer to yours at check-in.

I'm not sure what time we'll get there since we'll be coming from Glasgow.  I estimate we'll get there at about 5:00 (the wedding is at 7:00 right?) We'll actually be traveling to Glasgow on Friday since some of Hilary's family from the Borders will be there as well.

If we're not in contact before then, let's just plan on meeting at the hotel sometime between 6:00 and 6:30.  We can drive over to the wedding together from there.

In case you didn't know, they're registered at John Lewis - we got him a gift yesterday, still plenty of items on the list.

E
